name: sharedLD_from_equilibrium / sharedLDFromMigration
note: positive control 'one population split arbitrarily [F_ST = 0]' passed at 0.88 sems
regime: two-deme island model at Ne = 1000, 5 Mb with recombination 1e-8, 10 replicates; 4*Ne*m swept a hundredfold. F_ST is the site-frequency Hudson estimator (ratio of averages) and sharedLD is the correlation across SNP pairs between the signed LD r measured separately in each deme -- a DIFFERENT observable from F_ST, which is what makes the identity refutable. Pairs are restricted to sites common in BOTH demes so the pair set is not selected by one of them
